abhts_1.1.literal: stainless-art-abode-new-creation-great (vimalakalāśraya-abhinavasṛṣṭi-mahā) mother (jananī), full-bodied (bharitatanuḥ) five-faced-hidden-splendor (pañcamukha-gupta-ruciḥ) father (janakaḥ); of-the-two-their-yamal-burst-forth- being-emission-natured (tadubhayayāmala-sphurita-bhāva-visargamayam) heart (hṛdayam), unsurpassed-deathless-family (anuttara-amṛta-kulam) — for-me (mama) may-it-flash (saṃsphuratāt)
abhts_1.1.final: Mother of stainless art, of new great making, full-bodied one, five-faced Father, splendor hidden: may the Heart — deathless kin beyond all — flash forth for me.
abhts_1.1.note: | bulk-confirmed 2026-11-06 (owner blanket bless; T1 frozen scholarship, match 0.97)

abhts_1.2.literal: vast (vitataḥ) Tantrāloka (tantrālokaḥ) to-be-plunged (vigāhitum) not-possible (naiva śakyate) by-all (sarvaiḥ); in-plain-words-composed (ṛjuvacana-viracitam) this (idam) Tantrasāra (tantrasāram) therefore (tataḥ) listen (śṛṇuta)
abhts_1.2.final: The Tantrāloka spreads wide, and none at all can dive it — so hear this Tantrasāra, in plain words composed.
abhts_1.2.note: | bulk-confirmed 2026-11-06 (owner blanket bless; T1 frozen scholarship, match 0.96)

abhts_1.3.literal: By-the-fall-of-the-feet's-splendor (caraṇanipātaprabhā) of-Śambhunātha-Bhāskara (śrīśambhunātha-bhāskara) with-gone-contraction (apagatasaṃkocam) — Abhinavagupta's- heart-lotus (abhinavagupta-hṛdambujam) this (etad) pick (vicinuta) for-Maheśa-worship's-sake (maheśapūjanahetoḥ)
abhts_1.3.final: Heart-lotus of Abhinavagupta, uncontracted by Śambhunātha Sun's feet-fall light — gather it for Maheśa-worship.
abhts_1.3.note: | bulk-confirmed 2026-11-06 (owner blanket bless; T1 frozen scholarship, match 0.84)
